description: A tired-looking man in a short tunic, dark cloak and sandals, with a leather satchel across his chest, steps down from or beside a sweating dark horse on a cobbled yard at night. A second man on the right leads out a fresh horse by the reins. Stone arched doorways, timber-braced walls, a wall torch, a hanging lantern and a brazier fill the setting. Oil-painting style, no text, no frame, no gore.
